1password-access: Unlock 1Password on Windows. For Linux CLI access, configure an account before you start a session.
git-signing: Unlock the Windows signing agent. Check the Git signing identity in the Windows profile.
plugin-login-required: Complete Codex login before plugin installation.
plugin-marketplaces: Check each configured marketplace source. If a source is local, clone its repository before retrying.
plugin:: Check this plugin source and its required account access. Then retry account and plugin reconnection.
.config/git/: Check the source file in the Windows profile. Then retry bootstrap.
.aws: Check the AWS directory in the Windows profile.
.azure: Check the Azure directory in the Windows profile.
disk-temporary-storage: Check the configured temporary directory and its backing file system.
managed-python: Install the Python version from the profile with uv.
default: Retry bootstrap from the reviewed checkout. Check the reported command or path if the failure continues.
lighttpd-service: Run bootstrap to install and start the selected service.
codex-rules: Check the configured personal repository and GitHub access. Then retry rules installation.
